_note: Landing subsystem (GER) local numbers, owner D5, revision D5-R7 (D-76: F-400 cartridges, narrower sleeve; CR-A1-65, CR-C5-18, CR-C1-34, CR-C4-36; D-63, D-65; R4: CR-A1-34, D-30, C5-R3 cartridges). Read by fusion/landing.py (ctx.local) and team/D5/feet_calc.py (P:landing.*). Shared numbers (fin TE x, half-fin height 0.21, board, foot height 0.048, CG, loads) come from params/params.json and are not repeated here. Frame: params.json#frame (x aft, y right, z up, metres). Each foot is a telescoping crush unit in the fin plane: a bonded PETG shoe seated on a step cut in the half-fin TE tip (CL-D5-FIN-STEP-*) (the shoe wraps the board and both edge-strip ends, CR-C4-09), a PETG piston (one tine, two snap fingers, stop flange) with a neoprene pad, and an XPS crush cartridge from the piston floor to the shoe back wall. Stack along +x (down in hover): back wall, cartridge, piston floor/flange, pad; the flange stops on the sleeve-end rim after stroke_max_m. Upper feet (UR, UL) take solid type-U cartridges, lower feet (LR, LL) bored type-L cartridges; every cartridge segment is pre-crushed 1 mm on a press (C5-R3: plateau upper 39.4 N, lower 35.6 N, bias x1.05 / x0.95, CR-C5-10 revised).

section_y_m.note: R7 (D-76): 14.5 x 9.8 mm in FOAMULAR 400 (276 kPa): 142.1 mm2 gives type U 39.2 N, mean 37.5 N (C5-R3 target) as R6's 20.9 x 11.0 mm in F-250 did; the narrower section shrinks the sleeve and tine (-11 g on four feet). Tuning knob after T-D5-COUPON (y only). Was 0.0209 (R6, F-250), 0.0173 (R4)

section_z_m.note: R7 (D-76): 9.8 mm (was 11.0): with the 3.4 mm rim the fin step stays 9.0 mm deep (<= 10, CL-D5-FIN-STEP-DEPTH)

bore_lower_d_m.note: R7 (D-76): 5/32 in (3.97 mm) bore cut by a sharpened K&S 5/32 in brass tube: type L 129.7 mm2 -> 35.8 N, bias x1.045 vs C5's x1.05 (3/16 in gives x1.066, outside the 1 % band). Was 7/32 in (R4-R6, F-250 section)

segments.note: R6/R7: three ~34 mm pieces (cut 35 mm) across a 2 in board (crush axis = through-thickness)

material.value: XPS foam FOAMULAR 400 (40 psi, 2 in board; D-75)
material.note: R7 (D-76): was F-250 wing-core offcut. Buy one 2 in F-400 board (I1); T-D5-COUPON confirms the plateau before any shoe is printed. Fallback if F-400 cannot be had: R6 F-250 section 20.9 x 11.0 with the R6 shoe (+11 g, CG +1.1 mm)

clear_m.note: per side, cartridge in the piston bore

preload_m.note: cartridge cut 0.5 mm long so the hooks seat on the window aft edge without play

colour_upper.value: orange PETG piston + orange paint stripe on the cartridge (type U, solid)

colour_lower.value: blue PETG piston + blue paint stripe on the cartridge (type L, bored)

precrush_m.note: R6: each of the three segments is cut 1 mm long and pressed 1 mm on the drill press before assembly (CR-C5-10): removes the first-yield peak of every segment in the series stack; the pressed length is the CAD length

density_kgm3.note: R7 (D-76): F-400 ~2.0 pcf (estimate; the wing core F-250 is lighter); 0.5 g per cartridge, weighed at the coupon

wall_t_m.note: two 0.4 mm perimeters, 100 % solid; shoe sleeve and piston tine

slide_clear_m.note: per side, tine in sleeve (PETG on PETG); check with the first print

leg_depth_m.note: R4: 10 -> 7 mm to pay for the wider R4 cartridge (-1.2 g on four shoes); legs bonded to both fin faces below the step; bond RF stays >= 1.4 (CL-D5-BOND-SF)

glue_gap_m.note: per side between shoe and fin (epoxy line)

window_z_m.note: snap-finger window height in the two y walls of the sleeve

rim_t_m.note: R7 (D-76): 3.4 mm (R6 2.8) round the last rim_len of the narrower sleeve; D5 FEA 37.5 MPa (+y) at 59.25 N ult, RF 1.07 (R6 1.03). Roof side level with the pad edge (lip_m = rim_t_m)

rim_side_t_m.note: R8: rim thickness on the two y sides (outside the sleeve, aft of the fin TE, free space). +y side load at 59.25 N ult, R 2.0 fillets, h 0.4: rs 3.4 (floor 3.4) 35.5 MPa; rs 4.4 / 4.8 (floor 0.4) 29.3 / 28.3 MPa; rs 5.4 (floor 1.4) 28.2 MPa. Past ~4.8 the inboard window edge (28.3 MPa) governs. 4.6 is taken to keep the landing mass at or under R7. The roof side stays rim_t_m (= lip_m) so the rim top stays level with the pad edge and the fin step does not move

rim_floor_t_m.note: R8: rim on the floor side (below the sleeve floor, aft of the TE) cut to one 0.4 mm perimeter: it is not the stroke stop (the flange spans z_slv0..pad edge) and a thick floor rim stiffens the floor and raises the +y corner peak (h 0.4, R 2.0: rs 5.4 with floor 3.4 / 1.4 gives 28.9 / 28.2 MPa; rs 4.4 with floor 1.4 / 0.4 gives 30.1 / 29.3 MPa; rs 4.8 with floor 0.4 / 0 gives 28.3 / 30.0 MPa, so one perimeter is kept)

rim_len_m.note: must start aft of the fin TE

collar_len_m.note: two collar cheeks forward of the step front over both edge-strip ends (the strips end at the square-tip front, D3)

lip_m.note: R7: = shoe.rim_t_m; sleeve roof this far below the pad edge so the rim top is level with it (CL-D5-RIM-TOP-MARGIN >= 0)

wall_t_m.note: R6: sleeve floor, roof and y walls (three 0.4 mm perimeters); the tine and legs stay at wall_t_m 0.8. D5 FEA sweep (sim/out/sweep1, sweep2): 0.8/3.2 and 1.0/3.0 fail near the TE (56 / 50 MPa), 1.2/2.8 gives 34.1 MPa at 59.0 N ult (RF 1.17), 1.4/2.6 34.8 MPa and heavier; R7 (D-76): 1.2 kept on the 19.1 x 14.4 mm sleeve (FEA sweep sim/runs/log_k11_*, log_k12_*: ws 0.8 / 1.0 fail +y at 60 / 52 MPa on the narrow sleeve)

inside_fillet_r_m.note: R8: R 2.0 mm in the four inside corners of the sleeve, full length (modelled); the FEA peak sits in this corner. R 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0 at rim 3.4 give +y 37.6 / 38.8 / 35.5 MPa and +z 31.0 / 26.1 / 21.2 MPa (h 0.4). Tine chamfer piston.corner_chamfer_m 1.4 keeps 0.16 mm to the arc (CL-D5-FILLET-CLEAR)

w_m.note: copied, D3 owns it: CF 10 x 1 mm on both faces along the half-fin top edge; ends at the step front, wrapped by the collar

flange_t_m.note: R7 (D-76): 1.6 -> 1.8 mm: the flange is narrower (19.1 mm) with the narrower sleeve; SF 1.23 at C1's 80 N bound

engage_m.note: R6: 12 -> 25 mm (C5 variant): tine engagement in the sleeve before any crush; lowers the lip reaction R = F (a + e) / (e + s0) from 3.2 F to 2.2 F

hook_protrusion_m.note: hook 0.6 mm beyond the tine wall: 0.4 mm catch on the window aft edge; R6: 45 deg ramp on its forward face so any set > 1 mm cams it under the 3 mm window's front edge and it rides inside the wall (finger held at 1.7 % strain until the insert is pulled)

finger_len_m.note: free finger length >= 6.0 mm (CL-C6-SNAP-L-MIN); 6.5 mm gives 1.7 % strain

finger_w_m.note: finger width between the two slots

slot_w_m.note: two 0.8 mm slots in each tine y wall make the finger

window_rail_m.note: R8: 2.0 -> 2.5 mm rail each side of the inspection window: the 1.4 mm tine chamfer (needed by the R 2.0 sleeve fillets) costs tine section; with R8's CALC-D5-SIDE (windowed section at F (a - 3 mm), full section at F a) the tine SF is CL-D5-SIDE-TINE-SF. Window 10.7 -> 9.7 mm wide, still shows the cartridge stripe. R7 (D-76): 1.5 -> 2.0 mm

replace_mark_m.note: R4: 6 -> 3 mm. Groove on the tine 3 mm aft of the rim: once it is inside the sleeve, less than C5's pair-first stroke plus the 3 mm guard is left; replace the insert (CL-D5-MARK-MARGIN)

corner_chamfer_m.note: R8: 45 deg chamfer on the four outside corners of the tine so it clears the R 2.0 sleeve fillets with the 0.2 mm slide clearance: the chamfer ends sit sqrt((R-cs-tc)^2+(R-cs)^2) = 1.844 mm from the fillet centre, 0.156 mm inside the 2.0 mm arc (CL-D5-FILLET-CLEAR; R7 was 1.0 mm chamfer on R 1.0, 0.175 mm). With 1.0 mm the gap would be 0.030 mm

z_outer_m.note: outboard edge of the pad and flange (D-30, kept with the 0.21 m half-fins); tip-over pivot = z_outer - edge_r

edge_r_m.note: edge round on the flange and pad

stroke_max_m.note: flange-to-rim gap (D-30); the wing TE stays 10 mm off the ground at full stroke

span_m.note: spanwise length of the TPU corner cap on the fixed wingtip; inboard edge 1.5 mm outboard of the outboard elevon end (k9.elevon_spans: 0.560)

chord_m.note: chordwise depth of the cap legs forward of the TE

tape_g.note: two wraps of 12 mm filament tape over the cap legs

glue_g_per_foot.note: epoxy on the shoe (0.35) + foam-safe CA on the cartridge (0.05)

y_m.note: y of the ground field-kit row (one unit per GER-005..013 line), clear of the 0.576 m wingtip and the transport box; layout only, not a stowage claim (kit travels in TRN-108)

x_m.note: x centre of each kit item

sheet_y_m.note: y of the neoprene stock sheet, behind the kit row

tube_od_m.source: K&S catalogue 5/32 in round brass tube
tube_od_m.note: bore cutter OD (GER-013) = type-L bore 3.97 mm (D-76)

tube_wall_m.source: K&S catalogue 5/32 in round brass tube

tube_len_m.source: K&S catalogue 7/32 in round brass tube
